props.title: Begin Your Engineering Journey at JKKN
props.subtitle: Simple admission process with transparent eligibility criteria

criteria: Passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics
Minimum 45% aggregate marks (40% for reserved categories)
Valid TNEA counselling rank or direct admission
Age limit: Should have completed 17 years as on July 1st
Bachelor degree in any discipline with 50% marks
Valid TANCET / CAT / MAT / XAT score
Group discussion and personal interview clearance

faqs.answer: For 2026-27 AICTE has approved seven programmes: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering, B.E. Electrical and Electronics Engineering, B.E. Mechanical Engineering and B.Tech Information Technology (60 seats each), M.E. Computer Science and Engineering (12 seats) and MBA (60 seats).
faqs.question: What engineering courses are offered at JKKN Engineering College?

faqs.answer: Yes. JKKN College of Engineering and Technology is approved by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) for 2026-27 and affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. It is an autonomous institution, with autonomous status conferred by UGC, New Delhi and Anna University, Chennai, and it is accredited by NAAC with Grade B+.
faqs.question: Is JKKN Engineering College AICTE approved?

faqs.answer: Yes. JKKN College of Engineering and Technology (JKKNCET), Komarapalayam, is an autonomous institution: autonomous status has been conferred by UGC, New Delhi and Anna University, Chennai. The college remains affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, and is approved by AICTE for its B.E., B.Tech, M.E. and MBA programmes.
faqs.question: Is JKKN College of Engineering and Technology an autonomous college?

faqs.answer: Admission to B.E./B.Tech programs is through TNEA counselling or direct admission. Eligibility requires passing 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with minimum 45% aggregate marks. Fill out the online application, submit documents, attend counselling, pay fees, and complete enrollment.
faqs.question: What is the admission process for B.E./B.Tech programs?

faqs.answer: JKKN College of Engineering and Technology has a Training and Placement Cell that runs placement training and organises campus recruitment drives for final-year learners. The placement data the college files with NIRF every year is published on the NIRF page of the IQAC section of this website.
faqs.question: What is the placement record at JKKN Engineering College?

faqs.answer: We provide state-of-the-art facilities including 500+ computer systems in modern learning labs, engineering workshops, research learning labs for AI/ML/IoT/Robotics, digital library with 50,000+ books, Wi-Fi campus, separate hostels for boys and girls, cafeteria, sports complex, and transportation services.
faqs.question: What facilities are available for learners?

faqs.answer: Not for 2026-27. The AICTE Extension of Approval for 2026-27 lists seven programmes: B.E. CSE, ECE, EEE and Mechanical, B.Tech IT, M.E. CSE and MBA. There is no B.Tech AI & ML intake this year. For course questions, contact the admissions office at engg@jkkn.ac.in or +91 93458 55001.
faqs.question: Does JKKN offer a B.Tech in AI & Machine Learning?
